title: Home Delivery Rate Card for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Home delivery rate card — Vehicle Purchase Agreements.** Rates are per one-way mile from the selling store.

| Deal type | Home delivery offered | Free radius (one-way miles) | Charge per one-way mile beyond the free radius (USD) | Minimum home delivery fee once beyond the free radius (USD) | Greatest one-way delivery distance (miles) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | no | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 25 | 1.85 | 49.00 | 150 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | yes | 50 | 1.65 | 49.00 | 200 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 75 | 1.50 | 39.00 | 250 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | yes | 75 | 1.50 | 39.00 | 250 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | yes | 150 | 1.25 | 0.00 | 300 |

## Reading the card
- A deal type with home delivery "no" takes delivery at the showroom only. Its other columns are zero.
- The free radius, the per-mile charge and the minimum fee are the deal type's own figures. A minimum of 0.00 means the deal type has no minimum home delivery fee.
- The greatest distance is the farthest one-way distance to which the store delivers that deal type. Hypothetical: a delivery address 220 miles away is within reach for a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase only if it is no farther than 200 miles, so it is not; for a New Vehicle Retail Purchase it is within the 250-mile limit.
